name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Cortex goes with neither Callisto nor Diatoms.
Cortex goes with exactly one of Eklund, Fontaine, or Earth.
Dasari goes with at most one of Helix, Venus, and Diatoms.
Anders, Aurora, and Earth belong to different colonists.
Eklund goes with at least one of Helix or Europa.
Algae goes with exactly two of Eklund, Aurora, and Earth.
Diatoms goes with at most two of Dasari, Aurora, and Callisto.
Algae goes with none of Aurora, Cortex, or Venus.
Fontaine, Aurora, Earth, and Regolith belong to different colonists.
